## Checkpoint 17: a finite accepted candidate is the exact all-time candidate

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** This checkpoint pursued candidate construction and three global alternatives in parallel. Its main positive result strengthens checkpoint 16 without enlarging the finite premise: the same supplied candidate reaches the exact complementary cycle and remains compatible forever.

Published head: [4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9).
[Scientific packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/source-construction/README.md) · [Formal scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/source-construction/FORMAL_SCOPE.md) · [Execution and review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/reports/2026-11-23-source-construction/README.md)

### New Lean theorem

For a fixed positive ordinary n and signed triadic candidate a/3^r, retain

`F(r)=product_(j<r)(1+3^j)`, `B=n*max(1,|a|)*F(r)`, `E=bitlength(B)`, `H=9E+1`.

Passing the first H literal opposite-parity tests implies a clock tau<=8E with

`x_tau=1` and `w_tau=2*3^r_tau`.

The same candidate therefore passes every subsequent test. Lean proves finite/all-time equivalence with this candidate-dependent horizon. The new capstones in [TriadicCertificateRigidity.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/source-construction/lean/TriadicCertificateRigidity.lean) are:

- `CollatzTriadicRigidity.finite_triadic_exact_pair`
- `CollatzTriadicRigidity.finite_certificate_alltime`
- `CollatzTriadicRigidity.finite_certificate_iff_alltime`

The inherited potential and finite zero-tail argument yield an original hit by 8E. The terminal defect is smaller than 2^(E+1), while the remaining E+1 tests force divisibility by 2^(E+1). The defect is zero, and an exact-cycle invariant supplies all later tests. Initial zero, zero entry, n=1, and unreduced representations are included. Both inherited Lean dependencies are unchanged and pinned by hash.

### Written arithmetic consequences and construction attempt

The [exactness proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/source-construction/EXACT_CANDIDATE_RIGIDITY.md) proves additional written consequences. For n>2, reducing an accepted value to a*/3^r* gives `r*=b_tau-1` and

`tau <= ((r*+1)*log(3)-log(n))/log(3/2)`.

Here b_tau counts original even inputs before the first hit. Equality holds for power-of-two paths. Outside {1,2,4}, the candidate is negative with first sign crossing exactly `(8,-1/9)->(4,1/3)`. These are independently reconstructed written results, not additional Lean declarations.

The [construction attack](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/source-construction/CARRY_CONSTRUCTION_ATTACK.md) proves an all-target finite lift and an exact positive-sector reset telescope. Terminal interpolation still retains the same congruence lattice. It did not construct a candidate meeting its own horizon for every fixed original source.

The missing target remains: for every fixed positive n, construct signed a, r>=0 and K such that

`K >= 9*bitlength(n*max(1,|a|)*F(r))+1` and `2^K | 3^b_K*a+3^r*D_K`,

with D_K the complete complementary carry of n's actual K-bit word. The [standalone two-carry question](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/triadic-height/TWO_CARRY_CONSTRUCTION_QUESTION.txt) preserves the ordinary original source. The congruence-to-parity bridge remains the reviewed written checkpoint-16 argument.

### Other parallel attacks

| Route | Result | Missing closing input |
|---|---|---|
| [Infinite pressure-optimal ray](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/source-construction/INFINITE_OPTIMAL_RAY_ATTEMPT.md) | The fixed-source real/2-adic/3-adic linear-form product is exactly S(q_k)>=1. Negative rational cycle anchors give exact endpoint congruences. | A height saving or admissible better ancestor. The inspected fixed-anchor optimizer theorem gives no uniform onset for the changing anchors. |
| [Actual boundary and ordinary labels](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/source-construction/HAAR_AND_ORDINARY_LABELS.md) | Finite clock-erasure bound; conditional unthickened limit Haar x nu under an explicit Rajchman premise; exact mixed-phase recovery of the endpoint. | A bound for the same actual mixed-phase/cross-box collision observable. Actual Rajchman regularity is not proved. |
| [Complete cycle/product transfer](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/source-construction/CYCLE_PRODUCT_TRANSFER_ATTEMPT.md) | Every positive one-rise rational cycle has maximal multiplicative product set and minimal energy. Primitive nonintegral examples have arbitrary floor and arbitrarily large period. | A consequence of full ordinary integrality contradicting product growth, or a transfer to the complete carry zero fibre. |

For the cycle result, p>=2, A>p, 2^A>3^p give word 1^p0^(A-p), complete C=3^p-2^p and D=2^A-3^p. Its entire odd-state set B satisfies `|BB|=p(p+1)/2` and `E_x(B)=2p^2-p`. The shifted-valuation and arbitrary-floor arguments are universal written proofs, independently reconstructed. The controls are rational, not integer counterexamples. External incidence/energy results remain explicitly attributed and source-qualified.

### Validation

- Fresh strict author, independent-reviewer, and integration builds of the two unchanged project dependencies and new module.
- All **15 new theorem declarations plus 2 definitions** audited. Axiom union: `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`.
- Lean 4.34.1, compiler `5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52`; Mathlib `d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612`. Existing Mathlib/package objects reused.
- Four new exact checkers passed normally and with Python optimization, with identical output. Independent carry controls also matched.
- Rigidity controls: 21 accepted representations, 36 exact defect-clock failures, four zero rejections, one stale-horizon mutation.
- Cycle controls: 62 small cycles, 12,185 unordered products, 17,065 literal shortcut steps, three damaged inputs rejected. The large cases check every step and shifted valuation, not all quadratic products.
- All 23 frozen upstream source entries matched. [Source pins](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/source-construction/SOURCES.json) retain exact access and reconstruction scope.
- [Internal reviews](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4171e1fe40e41842af9f800bd821084b724cf8f9/reports/2026-11-23-source-construction/README.md) disclose source hashes, written/formal boundaries, and the reviewer's suggested n=1 simplification.
- The complete **clean 676-file checkout** passed the required integrity gate at the exact published head. Its tree equals the locally checked tree: `113a6e69c94e68063355f38f1632c6e758bdb9e2`.
- No expensive historical census or broad historical Lean suite was replayed. Repository integrity is not mathematical verification.

The scoped runner is `research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/source-construction/verify_checkpoint17.py`. Its committed receipt binds the final manifest and source bytes. The separate exact published-head integrity receipt stays outside the checkout to preserve the clean-tree requirement; SHA-256 `79c02dcca025c53e1cac3c472b9e2db831345b30afe40f23bbde0f50af3df0fc`.

**Strongest uncertainty:** the new theorem establishes exactness of a supplied successful finite candidate. It does not establish that every positive ordinary input has one. No universal escape exclusion or complete integer-cycle exclusion was obtained in the other lanes.
